editorial:
Ever wonder about the Kennedy family members who didn't end up in the history books? You get to meet Joe Kennedy Jr. in this old-school drama. He is the big brother to JFK, and instead of playing it safe, he wants to prove himself during World War II. The movie feels like a classic adventure story, focusing on his brave but risky plan to fly behind enemy lines. It captures that feeling of a young man trying to step out of his family's giant shadow while facing real danger in the sky.

What really works here is the tension during the flight scenes. The acting feels natural, though some of the special effects look dated since it is from the seventies. If you like historical stories that feel more like a spy mission than a lecture, you will enjoy this. It is a bit slow in the middle, but the payoff is worth it. You should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best look, or if you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for any history buff.
endingExplained: The movie ends on a sad note. After completing his dangerous mission and showing his bravery, Joe takes off for another flight. Tragically, his plane explodes in mid-air over England. You see the aftermath where his family has to deal with the loss. It wraps up by showing how his death changed his brother JFK and the rest of the Kennedy family forever, leaving them with a legacy of grief and duty.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves WWII history and family dramas.
